description: Represents a quest that a character has accepted and is currently progressing.

questDefinitionRef.description: A strong reference to the master quest definition record (com.cacheblasters.saga.proto.quest.definition).

status.description: The current status of the quest for this character.

progress.description: Arbitrary key-value data tracking specific quest objectives (e.g., {'goblins_slain': 4, 'key_found': true}).
